name: espn-league
description: The user's ESPN league. Full PPR, 4-pt pass TD, -2 INT, -2 fumble lost.
assumptions: D/ST points-allowed tier 18-27 (0 pts) is not shown on the league page; assumed to be the ESPN default.
D/ST yards-allowed tier 300-349 (0 pts) is not shown on the league page; assumed to be the ESPN default.
D/ST yards-allowed tiers 450-499 (-5), 500-549 (-6) and 550+ (-7) are not shown on the league page; assumed to be ESPN defaults.
D/ST Points Allowed leaves out the opponent's INT and fumble return TDs and counts its kick and punt return TDs (ESPN's definition per secondary sources); not confirmed on the league page.
D/ST Yards Allowed is the opponent's net offensive yards (sack yards subtracted); not confirmed on the league page.
No missed-PAT penalty: the league page shows none.
Return TDs and fumble-recovery TDs scored by offensive players are not modelled; they count as 0 points.
